subject: English
passage: In 1982, the restaurant industry introduced Taste-O-Matic. Establishments were equipped with electronic flavor dispensers that released tastes at predetermined moments during a ______ as the flavor of chocolate when desserts were featured on screen. Taste-O-Matic failed to catch on, however, with one food critic calling it "briefly amusing but ultimately gimmicky."
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The comma appropriately separates the nonessential descriptive aside "such as…screen" from the independent clause "Establishments were…presentation." Since the descriptive example of chocolate isn't necessary for the sentence to function, it needs to be set off with punctuation.
